links.outcome: Currency of ChatGPT's training data and clinical knowledge in obstetrics and gynecology answers
links.effect: Training data were not readily updated; the model did not reliably (if at all) source data from after 2021, so answers can be outdated.
links.quote: The specific model that was assessed here, seems to not reliably (if at all) source data from after 2021.

links.outcome: Ability of ChatGPT to cite sources for generated answers
links.effect: ChatGPT could not cite sources, so users cannot trace or verify its claims, which the authors say gives it the capability to mislead.
links.quote: An inability to cite sources or to truly understand what the user is asking suggests that it has the capability to mislead.

screen.reason: The authors conducted an empirical qualitative assessment of ChatGPT's responses to a series of obstetrics and gynecology clinical queries, evaluating performance and noting limitations.
